about: Looks applied by prepare_footage.py after the per-clip corrections (white balance, exposure), so every clip of a video shares one grade. Each playbook names one (playbooks/<id>.json "grade"). chain = an ffmpeg filter chain on 8-bit SDR video; wbStrength = how much of a measured colour cast is removed (1 = all of it), lower where warm light is part of the look. Checked on stills of real footage: see references/image-processing.md before changing a number. Only colour filters that can be baked into a 3D LUT belong in a chain (no vignette, noise, blur): those are looks of the template. `--grade-strength 0..1` (or a grade's own "strength") mixes the look with the corrected picture.

natural.about: True to life with a little punch: demos, tutorials, talking heads. Nothing that could exaggerate a result.

bright-interior.about: Property: lifted shadows and mids, clean whites, slightly warm, colours kept honest.

warm-food.about: Food: warm, a little more contrast and saturation, highlights kept. Warm light stays warm.

soft-skin.about: Fashion and beauty: gentle contrast, warm skin, protected highlights; fabric colours not pushed.

vivid.about: Montages and promos: rich colour and a firm S-curve, not neon.

teal-orange.about: Cinematic split tone, skin-safe: teal in the shadows, orange in the highlights, mids untouched so faces barely move. Not for white garments (white goes yellow) or close-up skin; use --grade-strength 0.5-0.7 to soften.

cinematic-fade.about: Lifted blacks and a slightly muted colour: the filmic, matte look. Black output about 0.045 (12/255, after the contrast step) reads against the platform's black bars; do not lift above about 0.07.

moody.about: Darker, cooler, contrasty: night, tech, drama. Phone screens in daylight crush it: check caption and title contrast on a still.

pastel.about: Airy, soft and light: lifted shadows, gentle colour, a little cool-warm split. White text vanishes on it (use outline or marker titles); apply to well-exposed clips only.

vintage-film.about: Faded film: lifted and tinted blacks, muted colour, warm highlights. The grain and vignette belong to the template's look (look.grain, look.vignette), not to the proxies.

mono.about: High-contrast black and white (Rec.709 luma weights, a firm S-curve). Never for a product whose colour is the claim.

bleach-bypass.about: Desaturated, hard and gritty: a firm S-curve and 45% saturation. Kills product colour: never for fashion, food or beauty demos.

golden-hour.about: Warm low sun: a 4500 K push (lower kelvin = warmer), orange highlights, a little more saturation. Leave white balance mostly alone (low wbStrength) or the correction undoes the warmth.

cold-blue.about: Cool blue (8500 K), slightly desaturated: tech, winter, clinical. Skin turns grey: keep --grade-strength <= 0.5 on people; never on food.
